failure_classifications.reason: Actual exit124 at predefined 1800s wrapper limit. Completed daemon/supervisor/lifecycle socket tests fail EPERM, preview/processalive assertions fail, and chat admission tests fail context deadline exceeded. Remaining package list is explicit in ao-quality-backend-broad-summary.json. No whole-backend PASS claimed.

Original queued lint attempt exits1 because independently requested lint already holds the tool lock. Independent pinned v2.13.2 lint exits0 with 0 issues. Queue guard was too late; neither recorded attempt was altered or erased.

After all shared dependencies were installed, complete GlobalSettingsForm and browser-history files rerun: 46 passed, 3 failed. History cap still exceeds 20s, Settings cannot find Updates heading and developer-mode test cannot find Updates channel. Correct main/e2e typechecks both pass; no application fix in this PR.

Current browser preparation exits 0. Complete native-runtime file has 23 passing tests and 1 failure: Daemon process exited during startup with no error output. AF_UNIX sandbox denial could explain it but this causal link is inference, not proven by this log.

356 files: 352 passed, 4 failed. 5580 tests: 5567 passed, 7 failed, 6 skipped. Four AF_UNIX supervisor tests fail EPERM; native browser fixture initially lacks prepared current-checkout binary; browser-history test times out at 20s; GlobalSettingsForm cannot find Updates heading. No failures relabelled PASS.

node --test scripts/*.test.mjs incorrectly invokes Vitest-based files without Vitest and TS extension resolution. All 13 exit 1. The proper full Vitest command already includes these script tests. Exact CI named .node-test.mjs helper commands separately pass.
AF_UNIX sockets are denied with EPERM; worker checkpoint tests fail.
Completed socket packages fail EPERM, Linux ConPTY process assertions fail, ACP SDK large-history replay overflows its 1024 notification queue.
Exact-source isolated race test exits 1 with notification queue overflow and peer disconnected; no repair in this PR.

Original baseline binary missing after VCS stamping failure; native handoff scripted reviewer cannot find git in hermetic PATH. Two diagnostic tests passed. Supplementary continuity success does not turn this full suite into PASS.
58 tests passed, 18 failed (chat/focus/notifications/board assertions), with daemon proxy ECONNREFUSED 3001. The pinned CI Playwright container was unavailable; root cause remains unresolved.
Offline cache lacks zxing-wasm 3.1.3. Node20 is also unavailable. Mobile checks not claimed passed.
Offline cache lacks yargs 17.7.3. No publication performed.

Initial current-checkout attempt omitted sibling dependencies, timed out or reported missing React/motion imports. Isolated shared package npm ci was subsequently completed and full typechecks rerun. Initial exits are preserved.
Exact go build exits 1 while obtaining VCS status in scratch; supplementary -buildvcs=false build preserves source behavior and is labelled separately.
